title: World-class cruise ship
description: Class of cruise ships under construction for MSC Cruises
extract: World Class ships are a class of cruise ships being built by Chantiers de l'Atlantique of France for MSC Cruises. The lead vessel, MSC World Europa, was delivered in October 2022 and the second, MSC World America, in March 2025. Six more ships in this class are planned for delivery between 2026 and 2031.
